title: Normative Statement Input
description: Input schema for the normative-statements skill: carry one recommendation, requirement or rule as a `recommendation` block (bean 55ao).

label.description: Stable identifier. The folio picks its own prefix convention (e.g. rec:) — the platform reserves none.

title.description: Short form for indexes and cross-references.

statement.description: The normative statement itself. One statement per block: a block holding three cannot be cited, reviewed or superseded individually.

list.description: A declared folio-code-list/v1 id, e.g. grade-recommendation-strength or rfc2119-requirement-level.

code.description: An active code in that list.

strength.description: The statement's strength as a code in a declared code list (owner ruling 2026-09-23, Q2): not a closed enum and not free text. Checked by strengthFinding (schemas/recommendation-strength.ts).

publishedNumber.description: The number this statement carries in the published edition. Kept out of the label, which must survive renumbering.

uses.description: Blocks a reader must have read to act on this one — term definitions, the scope statement, the evidence summary.

about.description: Labels of the DAK health-interventions this recommendation is about: a link, never a merge (owner ruling 2026-10-06, Q3).
